title: Self Hosted Pds
definition: The decision to self-host a Personal Data Store (PDS) for the Project Hierion, aligned with open-source values and ensuring full control.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Using our own server instead of relying on a third-party service like bsky.social for the Project Hierion's PDS.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Choosing self-hosting a PDS over using a third-party service like bsky.social for increased control and open-source alignment.
difficulty_levels.expert: The conscious decision to self-host a Personal Data Store (PDS) for the Project Hierion to ensure independence, control, and adherence to open-source values, with potential cost and setup considerations.

extra_fields.insight: Self-hosting for independence and control in an open-source project.
